title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: Calculate battle-panel WN8 from random-battle account and vehicle statistics; exclude legacy clan and company battles from local hangar WN8 totals and vehicle weights.
Update the Wargaming API application ID used for player statistics.

Refresh each statistics table every 24 hours, persist refresh times across restarts and retry failed updates after 30 minutes. Start downloads and apply refreshed tables only in the hangar; defer application of in-flight downloads until returning from battle.
Validate local statistics caches, preserve active tables when cached data is invalid, remove obsolete vehicle expectations on table replacement and enforce download deadlines after reads.
Adopt the revised in-game settings as defaults; align carousel statistic columns and icon rows with consistent font aliases.
Apply reticle-size correction consistently to artillery trajectory view and ballistic dispersion contours, preserving native impact positions and replay data.
Fix WN8 fallback averages and refresh expected-value caches after data updates.
Reject invalid statistics downloads while preserving the last usable cache; bound and close player-statistics responses.
Enable validation for develop, run every Gameface regression suite and make retry tests deterministic.
Remove the inactive hangar-efficiency panel and improve clock error diagnostics.
Center the minimap artillery aim in the camera frame at a fixed size and show it only in artillery and strategic modes.
Extend the minimap hull direction line to the map edge and document the {{cellsize}} map-size macro.

Add General settings and move the hangar clock there: clock.enabled and a list of positioned fields (text, shadow and background image) replace the size, background and single-format options. Configure the clock fields in the hangar settings panel.

CLEAN CONFIGURATION REQUIRED: back up personal images and sounds, remove the old mods/configs/driftkings folder before first launch, and configure the mod again in the hangar. Older settings and caches are no longer imported or cleaned up automatically.
Refresh the prestige widget visibility when Hangar preferences are enabled, disabled or changed.
Lay out clock text line by line like Flash, so negative leading places the weekday and date beside the time.
Add the Tomato.gg colour palette and WNX calculation for battle efficiency, battle results and the vehicle carousel, including assistance damage, formatting macros and WNX sorting.
Refresh WNX expected values through the existing daily hangar statistics worker and persistent cache; preserve valid cached data on download failure and show unavailable ratings as --.
Preserve customized rating thresholds and colours while fixing palette definition references; reproduce the Tomato.gg continuous colour scale.
Configure minimap map-size captions with HTML formatting, opacity, offsets, dimensions and a configurable shadow; migrate legacy font, colour and position settings.
Treat missing statistics caches as a normal first-start state and schedule downloads without an error traceback; retain diagnostics for corrupt or unreadable caches.

Use the native colorblind enemy palette for minimap names and lost icons; add a live colorblind roster macro and select the new alternate enemy HP texture while preserving the configured 14-pixel display height.

Integrate the tested vehicle markers with separate JSON documents and a tank sample in hangar settings: edit normal/ALT text, positions, health bars, damage, icons and colors with immediate preview. Changes use Apply/Save and take effect next battle; special modes retain native markers.
Link vehicle marker team, percentage HP and damage colors to the shared colorRating palettes, including the tank sample; preserve explicit marker color overrides.

Separate vehicle marker layouts by team, alive/destroyed state and normal/ALT mode, with independent text, native visibility, health bar, icon and floating-damage styles. Migrate previous JSON settings with original-file backups and edit each context in the tank preview.

Connect marker ratings to the shared statistics worker and cache. Add XVM-style r/c:xr fields, configurable WN8/WNX/EFF, structured font styles and an Add rating preset with matching preview. Calculate account WNX from complete random-only vehicle statistics and preserve unavailable or anonymized data as missing.

Add independent floating-damage styles for player, platoon and other authors, plus localized ammo-rack explosion messages. Add live distance, battle-role flags, comparisons and compound marker conditions, with matching editor previews and bounded expression validation.

Add marker health-bar gradients, independent fill opacity and author-coloured damage trails; configurable native indicators, visible stock-turret macros and local reusable templates, with matching editor controls. XMQP is not included.
Adopt the XVM default_wg vehicle-marker layouts without XMQP, with separate alive/destroyed and normal/ALT files; position HP and rating text on the health bar.
Resolve marker macros without replace callbacks, use a bullet glyph and support {{i18n:...}} localization macros, including translations for newer shell types.

Fix marker editor previews, labels, colour and slider limits; show sample-toggle states, report invalid marker references and treat null options as unset. Add editor regression coverage and the shared marker-condition fixture.
Fix local player statistics when subtracting legacy battle totals.
Share ActionScript colour, shadow and crosshair HUD helpers, and consolidate Python 2/3 string compatibility across settings, markers and updater modules.
Initialize the marks-of-excellence worker through clearData, share the damage-log enemy-name hook factory and fix Python 2 compatibility in test stubs.
